rows.source_ko: Chapter 1 General Provisions
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to define matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” and matters necessary for its implementation , such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established in the Ministry of Finance and Economy, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act” and advisory agencies equivalent thereto.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to define matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” and matters necessary for its implementation , such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established in the Ministry of Finance and Economy, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act” and advisory agencies equivalent thereto.

rows.source_ko: Chapter 2 Ministry of Finance and Economy
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Ministry of Finance and Economy

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Assistant Minister) The Assistant Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Assistant Minister) The Assistant Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Director General of International Economic Affairs) The Director General of International Economic Affairs shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Director General of International Economic Affairs) The Director General of International Economic Affairs shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Spokesperson) ① The Spokesperson shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Spokesperson) ① The Spokesperson shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② A Public Relations Officer shall be appointed under the Spokesperson, and the Public Relations Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.
rows.text_en: ② A Public Relations Officer shall be appointed under the Spokesperson, and the Public Relations Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ③ The Public Relations Officer assists the Spokesperson in the following matters.
rows.text_en: ③ The Public Relations Officer assists the Spokesperson in the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. Establishment and coordination of public relations plans for major policies with the media, and support and coordination of policy promotion to the media by related agencies
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of public relations plans for major policies with the media, and support and coordination of policy promotion to the media by related agencies

rows.text_en: 3. Operation and Support of the Electronic Briefing System

rows.text_en: 4. Management of external announcements regarding internal department business

rows.source_ko: 5. Matters concerning the establishment of press plans and the preparation and distribution of press releases
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the establishment of press plans and the preparation and distribution of press releases

rows.source_ko: 6. Analysis of Media Coverage Trends and Response to Major Policies
rows.text_en: 6. Analysis of Media Coverage Trends and Response to Major Policies

rows.source_ko: 7. Support and cooperation for Ministers and Vice Ministers' media-related duties and events, such as interviews
rows.text_en: 7. Support and cooperation for Ministers and Vice Ministers' media-related duties and events, such as interviews

rows.text_en: 8. Operation of the briefing room and other support tasks for media coverage activities

rows.text_en: 9. Analysis and Evaluation of Foreign Media Trends and Response to Misinformation

rows.text_en: 10. Preparation of materials for Minister and Vice Minister press conferences and interviews, and support for Investment Promotion (IR)

rows.source_ko: 11. Online overseas promotion, including operation of an English website
rows.text_en: 11. Online overseas promotion, including operation of an English website

rows.source_ko: 12. Production and distribution of English promotional materials
rows.text_en: 12. Production and distribution of English promotional materials

rows.source_ko: 13. Establishment, coordination, and implementation of plans to enhance the image of the Ministry of Finance and Economy and promote its policies
rows.text_en: 13. Establishment, coordination, and implementation of plans to enhance the image of the Ministry of Finance and Economy and promote its policies

rows.source_ko: 14. Operation of meetings related to policy promotion and consultation and coordination of economic policy promotion with relevant agencies
rows.text_en: 14. Operation of meetings related to policy promotion and consultation and coordination of economic policy promotion with relevant agencies

rows.source_ko: 15. Production and distribution of economic promotional materials and data
rows.text_en: 15. Production and distribution of economic promotional materials and data

rows.text_en: 16. Internet Homepage Operation and Online Media Operation and Management

rows.text_en: 17. Other duties designated by the spokesperson

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Auditor) ① The Auditor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Auditor) ① The Auditor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② One audit officer shall be appointed under the auditor, and the audit officer shall be appointed as a deputy director, science and technology secretary, or secretary.
rows.text_en: ② One audit officer shall be appointed under the auditor, and the audit officer shall be appointed as a deputy director, science and technology secretary, or secretary.

rows.source_ko: ③ The Audit Officer assists the Auditor in the following matters.
rows.text_en: ③ The Audit Officer assists the Auditor in the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. Matters concerning inspection duties
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning inspection duties

rows.source_ko: 2. Audit of the Ministry of Finance and Economy
rows.text_en: 2. Audit of the Ministry of Finance and Economy

rows.source_ko: 3. Audit of affiliated institutions and organizations (including affiliated public institutions and associations and organizations; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)
rows.text_en: 3. Audit of affiliated institutions and organizations (including affiliated public institutions and associations and organizations; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the registration and review of public officials' assets, reporting of gifts, and employment restrictions for retired public officials

rows.text_en: 5. Handling of audit results regarding the Ministry of Finance and Economy and its affiliated agencies and organizations by other agencies

rows.text_en: 6. Investigation and Handling of Complaints and Misconduct

rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the operation of the Code of Conduct for Public Officials and anti-corruption measures

rows.text_en: 9. Handling of other matters instructed by the Minister regarding audits

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Director of Strategic Planning) The Director of Strategic Planning shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Director of Strategic Planning) The Director of Strategic Planning shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: Article 7 (Secretary to the Minister) The Secretary to the Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Secretary to the Minister) The Secretary to the Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: Article 8 (Ministerial Policy Advisor) One of the Ministerial Policy Advisors shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. However, if the position is replaced by a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Ministerial Policy Advisor) One of the Ministerial Policy Advisors shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. However, if the position is replaced by a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: Article 9 (Director of Planning and Coordination Office) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Director of Planning and Coordination Office) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② Pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination shall be the Policy Planning Officer and the Emergency Safety Planning Officer. The Policy Planning Officer shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. The Emergency Safety Planning Officer shall be appointed as a fixed-term civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination shall be the Policy Planning Officer and the Emergency Safety Planning Officer. The Policy Planning Officer shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. The Emergency Safety Planning Officer shall be appointed as a fixed-term civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책기획관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제12조제3항제1호부터 제19호까지의 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Policy Planning assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to matters under subparagraphs 1 through 19 of Article 12 , Paragraph 3 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ④ 비상안전기획관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제12조제3항제20호부터 제25호까지의 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Emergency Safety Planning assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to matters under subparagraphs 20 through 25 of Article 12, Paragraph 3 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 기획조정실장 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신정책담당관ㆍ규제개혁법무담당관ㆍ정보화담당관을 두되, 각 담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ Under the Director of Planning and Coordination, there shall be a Planning and Finance Officer, an Innovation Policy Officer, a Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs Officer, and an Information Technology Officer, each of whom shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 기획재정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Planning and Finance Officer assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 주요 정책과 계획의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Integration and coordination of major policies and plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 주요 업무계획의 지침수립과 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of guidelines and comprehensive coordination of major work plans

rows.source_ko: 3. 주요 현안업무 점검을 위한 간부회의의 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of executive meetings to review major pending tasks

rows.source_ko: 4. 국회 관련 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and coordination of National Assembly-related affairs

rows.source_ko: 5. 당정협의 등 정당 관계 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management and coordination of party-related affairs, including party-government consultations

rows.source_ko: 6. 부 내 예산 및 기금의 편성ㆍ집행ㆍ조정의 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of the formulation, execution, and coordination of the Ministry's budget and funds

rows.source_ko: 7. 부 내 재정사업 성과계획서 및 성과보고서 작성 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of preparation of performance plans and performance reports for internal financial projects

rows.source_ko: 8. 부 내 국가재정운용계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and coordination of national fiscal management plans within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 9. 재정경제부장관 소속 외청의 지휘ㆍ감독에 관한 업무 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 9. Overall management and coordination of duties regarding the command and supervision of external agencies under the Minister of Finance and Economy

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 부 내 다른 실ㆍ국의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항과 실 내 다른 담당관의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항의 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management of other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions or bureaus within the Ministry, and matters not under the jurisdiction of other officials within the division

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 혁신정책담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Innovation Policy Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 재정경제부 연두 업무보고서 작성 총괄 및 추진실적 점검
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of the Ministry of Finance and Economy's annual work report and review of implementation results

rows.source_ko: 2. 주요 정책 및 업무계획의 추진실적 점검
rows.text_en: 2. Review of implementation progress of major policies and work plans

rows.source_ko: 3. 부 내 국정과제, 대통령 지시사항 및 장ㆍ차관 지시사항의 총괄ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management of national policy tasks within the Ministry, presidential directives, and directives from ministers and vice-ministers

rows.source_ko: 4. 정책상황 관련 대외 협의ㆍ조정 및 정책과제 관리
rows.text_en: 4. External consultation and coordination regarding policy situations and management of policy tasks

rows.text_en: 5. Operation of a consultative body for monitoring policy status and responding to

rows.source_ko: 6. 성과관리를 위한 장ㆍ단기 시행계획의 수립, 성과평가 위원회의 운영 및 정부업무평가 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment of long-term and short-term implementation plans for performance management, operation of the Performance Evaluation Committee, and overall management of government performance evaluations

rows.source_ko: 7. 갈등관리에 대한 종합시책 수립ㆍ추진 및 갈등관리위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and implementation of comprehensive policies for conflict management and operation of the Conflict Management Committee

rows.source_ko: 8. 정책품질의 향상 등 정책관리업무의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Comprehensive coordination of policy management tasks, including improvement of policy quality

rows.source_ko: 9. 국내 및 해외 주요 경제정책 동향 관련 자료의 분석ㆍ보고
rows.text_en: 9. Analysis and Reporting of Data Related to Major Domestic and Overseas Economic Policy Trends

rows.source_ko: 10. 경제교육 지원법령 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Operation of Economic Education Support Act

rows.source_ko: 11. 경제교육 활성화를 위한 정책의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 11. Formulation and coordination of policies to promote economic education

rows.source_ko: 12. 지역경제교육센터 지정ㆍ운영 등 지역경제교육 활성화
rows.text_en: 12. Revitalization of regional economic education, including designation and operation of regional economic education centers

rows.source_ko: 13. 부 내 정부혁신 관련 과제 발굴ㆍ선정, 추진상황 확인ㆍ점검 및 성과관리
rows.text_en: 13. Identification and selection of government innovation-related tasks within the Ministry, verification and monitoring of implementation status, and performance management

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 규제개혁법무담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Regulatory Reform Legal Affairs Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 부 내 규제개혁 및 정비에 관한 사무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of affairs regarding regulatory reform and streamlining within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 4. 행정소송 및 행정심판 사무의 총괄

rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and implementation of plans to improve civil complaint satisfaction

rows.source_ko: 9. 민원행정서비스 자체 만족도조사 및 제도개선과제 발굴
rows.text_en: 9. Internal satisfaction survey of civil administrative services and identification of institutional improvement tasks

rows.source_ko: 10. 자체 민원행정관리위원회의 관리ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 10. Management and Operation of the Internal Civil Complaint Administration Management Committee

rows.source_ko: 11. 민원통계 관리 및 민원사무와 관련된 부 내외 협력사항
rows.text_en: 11. Management of civil complaint statistics and internal and external cooperation matters related to civil complaint administration

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 정보화담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Information Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 부 내 정보화계획의 수립ㆍ총괄 및 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, overall management, and administration of internal informatization plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 부 내 정보시스템의 구축ㆍ도입ㆍ개발에 관한 사항 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of matters concerning the establishment, introduction, and development of information systems within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 3. 지식정보체계의 구축 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of knowledge information systems

rows.source_ko: 4. 부 내 정보화사업에 대한 평가 및 정부업무 정보화부문 평가 대응
rows.text_en: 4. Evaluation of internal IT projects and response to the evaluation of the government IT sector

rows.text_en: 5. Prior review and adjustment of the department's IT budget

rows.source_ko: 6. 부 내 정보보안 및 통신망을 통한 개인정보보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning internal information security and protection of personal information through communication networks

rows.source_ko: 7. 부 내 및 산하기관의 정보통신 보안, 정보자원 관리계획 수립 및 정보기술아키텍처(EA) 관리ㆍ운영
