rows.source_ko: 11. 부 내 데이터기반행정 활성화를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ 추진 및 데이터 관리 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 11. Overall management of planning, implementation, and data management for the activation of data-based administration within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 제10조(경제공급망기획관) ① 경제공급망기획관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Director of Economic Supply Chain Planning) ① The Director of Economic Supply Chain Planning shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 경제공급망기획관 밑에 공급망정책담당관 및 공급망대응담당관을 두되, 각 담당관은 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② A Supply Chain Policy Officer and a Supply Chain Response Officer shall be placed under the Economic Supply Chain Planning Officer, and each officer shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ③ 공급망정책담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 경제공급망기획관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Supply Chain Policy Officer assists the Economic Supply Chain Planning Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 경제안보를 위한 공급망 안정화 정책에 관한 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of supply chain stabilization policies for economic security

rows.source_ko: 2. 「경제안보를 위한 공급망 안정화 지원 기본법」 제7조에 따른 공급망 안정화 기본계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of the Basic Plan for Supply Chain Stabilization pursuant to Article 7 of the Framework Act on Support for Supply Chain Stabilization for Economic Security

rows.source_ko: 3. 「경제안보를 위한 공급망 안정화 지원 기본법」 제8조에 따른 공급망 안정화 시행계획 수립의 지원ㆍ조정 및 평가
rows.text_en: 3. Support, coordination, and evaluation of the establishment of supply chain stabilization implementation plans pursuant to Article 8 of the Framework Act on Support for Supply Chain Stabilization for Economic Security

rows.source_ko: 4. 공급망안정화위원회 및 분야별 전문위원회의 구성ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Composition and Operation of the Supply Chain Stabilization Committee and Sectoral Expert Committees

rows.source_ko: 5. 「소재ㆍ부품ㆍ장비산업 경쟁력 강화 및 공급망 안정화를 위한 특별조치법」 제8조제1항에 따른 소재ㆍ부품ㆍ장비 경쟁력강화위원회의 구성ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 5. Composition and operation of the Materials, Parts, and Equipment Competitiveness Enhancement Committee pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Special Measures Act for Strengthening Competitiveness of the Materials, Parts, and Equipment Industry and Stabilizing Supply Chains

rows.source_ko: 6. 공급망 현황조사 및 통계ㆍ정보 관리 시책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management and coordination of supply chain status surveys and policies for statistics and information management

rows.source_ko: 7. 경제안보품목 및 경제안보서비스의 지정 및 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the designation and management of economic security items and economic security services

rows.source_ko: 8. 공급망 안정화를 위한 지원 시책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management and coordination of support measures for supply chain stabilization

rows.source_ko: 9. 공급망 안정을 위한 정책의 평가
rows.text_en: 9. Evaluation of Policies for Supply Chain Stability

rows.source_ko: ④ 공급망대응담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 경제공급망기획관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Supply Chain Response Officer assists the Economic Supply Chain Planning Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 공급망 위험 점검 및 공급망 위기 관리ㆍ대응 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of supply chain risk assessment and supply chain crisis management and response policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 「경제안보를 위한 공급망 안정화 지원 기본법」 제15조에 따른 조기경보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영에 관한 총괄ㆍ조정 및 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management, coordination, and support regarding the establishment and operation of an early warning system pursuant to Article 15 of the Framework Act on Support for Supply Chain Stabilization for Economic Security

rows.source_ko: 3. 공급망위기 대응을 위한 위기대응 매뉴얼 표준안의 마련ㆍ통보
rows.text_en: 3. Preparation and Notification of Standard Crisis Response Manuals for Supply Chain Crises

rows.source_ko: 4. 관계 중앙행정기관의 소관 분야 위기대응 매뉴얼 작성ㆍ운용 실태 총괄ㆍ점검 및 조치 권고
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and inspection of the status of crisis response manual preparation and operation by relevant central administrative agencies in their respective fields, and recommendations for measures

rows.source_ko: 5. 「경제안보를 위한 공급망 안정화 지원 기본법」 제2조제8호에 따른 위기품목의 지정ㆍ해제 및 수급 안정화를 위한 조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the designation and de-designation of crisis items and measures for supply and demand stabilization pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 8 of the Framework Act on Support for Supply Chain Stabilization for Economic Security

rows.source_ko: 6. 공급망 위기 상황에 대한 범정부 차원의 대응에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning government-wide response to supply chain crises

rows.source_ko: 7. 공급망안정화기금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 정책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding the creation and operation of the Supply Chain Stabilization Fund

rows.source_ko: 8. 공급망안정화기금운용심의회의 구성ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the composition and operation of the Supply Chain Stabilization Fund Management Deliberation Council

rows.source_ko: 9. 공급망 안정화를 위한 외국정부 또는 민간과의 공동연구, 인력 교류 등 국제협력
rows.text_en: 9. International cooperation, such as joint research and personnel exchanges with foreign governments or the private sector, to stabilize the supply chain

rows.source_ko: 제11조(인사과) 인사과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Personnel Division) The Head of the Personnel Division shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: 제12조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: 제13조(혁신성장실) ① 혁신성장실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Innovation Growth Office) ① The Head of the Innovation Growth Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「재정경제부 직제」 제16조제1항에 따라 혁신성장실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 정책조정관 및 전략경제정책관으로 하며, 정책조정관 및 전략경제정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 16 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Innovation Growth Office shall be the Policy Coordinator and the Strategic Economic Policy Officer, and the Policy Coordinator and the Strategic Economic Policy Officer shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the positions shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책조정관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제16조제3항제1호부터 제23호까지의 사항에 관하여 혁신성장실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Policy Coordinator assists the Director of the Innovation and Growth Office with respect to matters under subparagraphs 1 through 23 of Article 16 , Paragraph 3 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ④ 전략경제정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제16조제3항제24호부터 제39호까지의 사항에 관하여 혁신성장실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Strategic Economic Policy assists the Director of the Innovation Growth Office with respect to matters under subparagraphs 24 through 39 of Article 16 , Paragraph 3 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 혁신성장실에 정책조정총괄과ㆍ산업경제과ㆍ서비스경제과ㆍ지역경제정책과ㆍ기업환경과ㆍ녹색전환경제과ㆍ전략경제총괄과ㆍ전략경제분석과ㆍ전략투자지원과ㆍ전략수출지원과 및 인공지능경제과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Innovation Growth Office shall have the Policy Coordination Division, Industrial Economy Division, Service Economy Division, Regional Economy Policy Division, Business Environment Division, Green Transition Economy Division, Strategic Economy Division, Strategic Economy Analysis Division, Strategic Investment Support Division, Strategic Export Support Division, and Artificial Intelligence Economy Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 정책조정총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Policy Coordination Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 경제관계장관회의 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Operation of the Economic Relations Ministers' Meeting

rows.source_ko: 2. 경제차관회의 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of the Economic Vice-Ministers' Meeting

rows.source_ko: 3. 기업구조의 개선 및 기업 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Improvement of corporate structure and consultation and coordination of corporate-related policies

rows.source_ko: 4. 다수의 부처가 관련된 경제정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and coordination of economic policies involving multiple ministries

rows.source_ko: 5. 국내외 위기상황에 대한 경제적 측면의 대응 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management and coordination of economic responses to domestic and international crisis situations

rows.source_ko: 6. 경제정책과 관련된 다수 부처의 중장기 업무계획의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and coordination of mid-to-long-term work plans of multiple ministries related to economic policy

rows.source_ko: 7. 내수와 수출간 균형개선을 위한 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management and coordination of policies to improve the balance between domestic demand and exports

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 국내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 산업경제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Industrial Economy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 지식기반경제 발전시책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of policies for the development of the knowledge-based economy

rows.source_ko: 2. 산업연관분석 및 관련 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of input-output analysis and related policies

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업경쟁력강화 관계장관회의 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the Ministerial Meeting on Strengthening Industrial Competitiveness

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업의 균형발전과 경쟁력강화를 위한 기본방향의 수립 및 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of basic directions for balanced industrial development and strengthening of competitiveness, and consultation and coordination of related policies

rows.source_ko: 5. 투자 촉진을 위한 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of policies to promote investment

rows.source_ko: 6. 중소ㆍ벤처기업 지원 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and coordination of policies related to support for SMEs and venture companies

rows.source_ko: 7. 제조업 및 농ㆍ림ㆍ수산업 관련 주요 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of major policies related to the manufacturing industry and agriculture, forestry, and fisheries

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 서비스경제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Service Economy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 서비스산업과 관련된 주요 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of major policies related to the service industry

rows.source_ko: 2. 서비스산업 경쟁력 강화 관련 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of policies related to strengthening the competitiveness of the service industry

rows.source_ko: 3. 지식기반서비스 및 사업지원서비스 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of policies related to knowledge-based services and business support services

rows.source_ko: 4. 서비스산업의 생산성 제고 및 연구개발 활성화 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of policies related to enhancing productivity and promoting research and development in the service industry

rows.source_ko: 5. 문화ㆍ관광산업과 관련된 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of policies related to the culture and tourism industry

rows.source_ko: 6. 전통문화의 산업적 육성과 관련된 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and coordination of policies related to the industrial promotion of traditional culture

rows.source_ko: 7. 국민의 여가생활과 관련된 시책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of policies related to the public's leisure life

rows.source_ko: 8. 서비스산업의 수출 활성화와 관련된 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management and coordination of policies related to the promotion of service industry exports

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 지역경제정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Regional Economic Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국토의 계획 및 개발 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation and coordination of policies related to national land planning and development

rows.source_ko: 2. 지역균형발전 및 지방경제 활성화를 위한 시책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of policies for balanced regional development and revitalization of the local economy

rows.source_ko: 3. 사회간접자본 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of policies related to social infrastructure

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업입지 및 토지이용 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of policies related to industrial location and land use

rows.source_ko: 5. 유통구조 발전시책의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and coordination of policies for the development of the distribution structure

rows.source_ko: 6. 유통효율화시책 및 물류비용 절감시책의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and coordination of measures for distribution efficiency and logistics cost reduction

rows.source_ko: 7. 시ㆍ도경제협의회의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of City and Provincial Economic Councils

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 기업환경과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Corporate Environment Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 기업환경 개선을 위한 제도 개선 및 지원 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation and coordination of institutional improvements and support policies to improve the business environment

rows.source_ko: 2. 기업경쟁력 강화 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Consultation and coordination of policies related to strengthening corporate competitiveness

rows.source_ko: 3. 기업환경 개선ㆍ기업경쟁력 강화 관련 기본계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and coordination of basic plans related to improving the business environment and strengthening corporate competitiveness

rows.source_ko: 4. 대ㆍ중소기업 상생협력 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of policies related to win-win cooperation between large and small businesses

rows.source_ko: 5. 경제분야 규제완화 관련 사항에 대한 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination on matters related to deregulation in the economic sector

rows.source_ko: 6. 경제분야 형벌 관련 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management and coordination of policies related to criminal penalties in the economic sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 기업의 경쟁력 제고 사항 및 경영애로 사항에 대한 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 7. Investigation and analysis of matters concerning the enhancement of corporate competitiveness and management difficulties

rows.source_ko: 8. 세계은행 등 국제기구의 기업환경평가에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 8. Work related to business environment assessments by international organizations such as the World Bank

rows.source_ko: 9. 시장구조의 개선 및 공정한 거래질서 확립에 관한 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 9. Consultation and coordination of policies regarding the improvement of market structure and the establishment of a fair trading order

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 녹색전환경제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 11 The Head of the Green Transition Economy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 에너지 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation and coordination of energy-related policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 국내외 자원개발 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Consultation and coordination of domestic and international resource development policies

rows.source_ko: 3. 환경산업 및 녹색성장 관련 경제정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of economic policies related to the environmental industry and green growth

rows.source_ko: 4. 기후변화ㆍ탈탄소 및 온실가스 감축 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of policies related to climate change, decarbonization, and greenhouse gas reduction

rows.source_ko: 5. 녹색경제 전환 관련 경제정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of economic policies related to the transition to a green economy

rows.source_ko: 6. 온실가스 배출권거래제 관련 경제정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and Coordination of Economic Policies Related to the Greenhouse Gas Emission Trading System

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 전략경제총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 12 The Head of the Strategic Economy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 경제혁신과 성장을 위한 전략적 경제정책 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of strategic economic policies for economic innovation and growth

rows.source_ko: 2. 초혁신경제 이행을 위한 추진계획 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and coordination of implementation plans for the execution of the hyper-innovation economy

rows.source_ko: 3. 대내외 경제환경 변화 대응을 위한 국내 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of domestic policies to respond to changes in the domestic and international economic environment

rows.source_ko: 4. 전략적 경제정책 관련 주요 산업 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of major industrial policies related to strategic economic policies

rows.source_ko: 5. 전략적 경제정책 관련 주요 산업에 대한 금융 및 자금지원 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of financial and funding support policies for key industries related to strategic economic policies

rows.source_ko: 6. 전략적 경제정책 관련 주요 산업을 위한 기금ㆍ펀드의 운용ㆍ관리에 대한 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and coordination regarding the operation and management of funds and endowments for key industries related to strategic economic policy

rows.source_ko: 7. 신산업 등 신성장동력 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of policies related to new growth engines, such as new industries

rows.source_ko: 8. 과학기술 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 8. Consultation and support for science and technology-related policies

rows.source_ko: 9. 국가연구개발사업 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 9. Consultation and support for policies related to national R&D projects

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 국내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions

rows.source_ko: ⑬ 전략경제분석과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 13 The Head of the Strategic Economic Analysis Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 경제혁신과 성장을 위한 경제분야 정책 관련 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 1. Survey and Analysis of Economic Policies for Economic Innovation and Growth

rows.source_ko: 2. 전략적 경제정책 관련 국내외 경제ㆍ산업 동향의 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 2. Investigation and analysis of domestic and international economic and industrial trends related to strategic economic policy

rows.source_ko: 3. 대내외 경제환경 변화 대응을 위한 국내 경제ㆍ산업의 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 3. Survey and Analysis of the Domestic Economy and Industry to Respond to Changes in the Domestic and International Economic Environment

rows.source_ko: 4. 대외 통상환경 관련 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 활용 방안 수립
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of plans for the collection, analysis, and utilization of information related to the external trade environment

rows.source_ko: 5. 신산업 동향 점검ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 5. Review and Analysis of New Industry Trends

rows.source_ko: 6. 전략적 경제 관련 투자ㆍ수출 관련 동향의 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 6. Investigation and Analysis of Trends Related to Investment and Exports in the Strategic Economy

rows.source_ko: ⑭ 전략투자지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 14. The Head of the Strategic Investment Support Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 통상환경 변화에 대응한 전략적 경제 관련 투자 지원 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation and coordination of investment support policies related to the strategic economy in response to changes in the trade environment

rows.source_ko: 2. 전략적 경제 관련 투자를 위한 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Support for strategic economic investments

rows.source_ko: 3. 전략적 경제 관련 투자를 위한 재원조달 방안 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and coordination of financing plans for strategic economic investments

rows.source_ko: 4. 전략적 경제 관련 투자를 위한 국제협력 및 국내외 기업ㆍ기관과의 협력 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Support for international cooperation for strategic economic investments and cooperation with domestic and foreign companies and institutions

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 전략수출지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 15. The Head of the Strategic Export Support Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 전략적 경제 관련 수출ㆍ해외수주 지원 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation and coordination of support policies for exports and overseas orders related to the strategic economy

rows.source_ko: 2. 전략적 경제 관련 수출ㆍ해외수주 지원제도의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Consultation and coordination of support systems for exports and overseas orders related to the strategic economy

rows.source_ko: 3. 전략적 경제 관련 수출ㆍ해외수주를 위한 금융지원 계획의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of financial support plans for strategic economy-related exports and overseas orders

rows.source_ko: 4. 전략적 경제 관련 수출ㆍ해외수주를 위한 국제협력 및 국내외 기업ㆍ기관과의 협력 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Support for international cooperation and collaboration with domestic and foreign companies and institutions for strategic economy-related exports and overseas orders

rows.source_ko: 5. 전략적 경제 관련 수출ㆍ해외수주 기업에 대한 현지 실태조사 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Support for on-site fact-finding surveys of companies involved in strategic economy-related exports and overseas orders

rows.source_ko: ⑯ 인공지능경제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 16. The Head of the Artificial Intelligence Economy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인공지능 관련 경제정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation and coordination of economic policies related to artificial intelligence

rows.source_ko: 2. 인공지능 산업 육성 관련 경제정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Consultation and coordination of economic policies related to fostering the artificial intelligence industry

rows.source_ko: 3. 인공지능 활용 확산 관련 경제정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of economic policies related to the widespread use of artificial intelligence

rows.source_ko: 4. 인공지능 분야 인프라 구축 등 기반조성 관련 경제정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of economic policies related to foundation building, such as the establishment of infrastructure in the artificial intelligence sector

rows.source_ko: 5. 인공지능 경제정책 관련 국제협력에 대한 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination on international cooperation regarding AI economic policy

rows.source_ko: 6. 국내외 인공지능 관련 경제정책 동향의 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 6. Investigation and Analysis of Domestic and International Trends in Economic Policies Related to Artificial Intelligence

rows.source_ko: 7. 정보화촉진 및 정보통신산업 발전정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of policies for the promotion of informatization and the development of the information and communications industry

rows.source_ko: 제14조(세제실) ① 세제실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Tax Policy Division) ① The Head of the Tax Policy Division shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「재정경제부 직제」 제17조제1항에 따라 세제실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 조세총괄정책관ㆍ소득법인세정책관ㆍ재산소비세정책관ㆍ국제조세정책관 및 관세정책관으로 하며, 조세총괄정책관ㆍ소득법인세정책관ㆍ재산소비세정책관ㆍ국제조세정책관 및 관세정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 17 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Tax Policy Division shall be the Director General of Tax Policy, the Director General of Income and Corporate Tax Policy, the Director General of Property and Consumption Tax Policy, the Director General of International Tax Policy, and the Director General of Customs Policy; the Director General of Tax Policy, the Director General of Income and Corporate Tax Policy, the Director General of Property and Consumption Tax Policy, the Director General of International Tax Policy, and the Director General of Customs Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 조세총괄정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제17조제3항제1호부터 제20호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General of Tax Policy assists the Director General with respect to matters under subparagraphs 1 through 20 of Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ④ 소득법인세정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제17조제3항제24호부터 제27호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Income and Corporate Tax Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under subparagraphs 24 through 27 of Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 재산소비세정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제17조제3항제32호부터 제37호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of Property and Consumption Tax Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under subparagraphs 32 through 37 of Article 17 , Paragraph 3 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 국제조세정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제17조제3항제21호부터 제23호까지 및 제28호부터 제31호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director of International Tax Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under Article 17, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 21 through 23 and Subparagraphs 28 through 31 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 관세정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제17조제3항제38호부터 제52호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Director of Customs Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under subparagraphs 38 through 52 of Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 세제실에 조세정책과ㆍ조세특례제도과ㆍ조세추계과ㆍ조세분석과ㆍ소득세제과ㆍ법인세제과ㆍ금융세제과ㆍ재산세제과ㆍ부가가치세제과ㆍ환경에너지세제과ㆍ국제조세제도과ㆍ관세제도과ㆍ산업관세과ㆍ관세협력과 및 자유무역협정관세이행과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Taxation Bureau shall have the Tax Policy Division, Special Taxation Division, Tax Estimation Division, Tax Analysis Division, Income Tax Division, Corporate Tax Division, Financial Tax Division, Property Tax Division, Value Added Tax Division, Environment and Energy Tax Division, International Taxation Division, Customs System Division, Industrial Customs Division, Customs Cooperation Division, and Free Trade Agreement Customs Implementation Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 조세정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Tax Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 조세정책 및 제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, formulation, and overall management and coordination of tax policies and systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 중장기 조세정책 및 제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Planning, formulation, and overall coordination of mid-to-long-term tax policies and systems

rows.source_ko: 3. 중장기 조세개혁 과제의 발굴
rows.text_en: 3. Identification of Mid-to-Long-Term Tax Reform Tasks

rows.source_ko: 4. 국세청ㆍ관세청의 중요정책 수립과 관련된 지휘에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the command related to the formulation of important policies of the National Tax Service and the Korea Customs Service

rows.source_ko: 5. 법령에 의해 국세청장ㆍ관세청장에게 위임한 사항과 관련된 협의ㆍ보고
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and reporting regarding matters delegated to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service and the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service pursuant to laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 6. 조세법령 정비 사업에 관한 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Planning, drafting, and overall coordination of tax law revision projects

rows.source_ko: 7. 「국세기본법」ㆍ「국세징수법」ㆍ「조세범 처벌법」 및 「조세범 처벌절차법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 7. Planning and drafting of systems concerning the Framework Act on National Taxes , the National Tax Collection Act , the Act on the Punishment of Tax Offenses , and the Act on the Procedures for the Punishment of Tax Offenses

rows.source_ko: 8. 제5호에 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 8. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general guidelines on national taxation related to Item 5

rows.source_ko: 9. 「국세기본법」ㆍ「국세징수법」ㆍ「조세범 처벌법」ㆍ「조세범 처벌절차법」과 「지방세기본법」ㆍ「지방세징수법」의 조정
rows.text_en: 9. Coordination of the Framework Act on National Taxes , the National Tax Collection Act , the Act on Punishment of Tax Offenses , and the Act on Procedures for Punishment of Tax Offenses with the Framework Act on Local Taxes and the Local Tax Collection Act

rows.source_ko: 10. 조세 법령에 대한 조세심판원 심판례, 법원 판례 등의 분석
rows.text_en: 10. Analysis of Tax Tribunal rulings, court precedents, etc. regarding tax laws

rows.source_ko: 11. 조세 법령의 해석 관련 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 11. Overall management and coordination of affairs related to the interpretation of tax laws

rows.source_ko: 12. 세제(관세는 제외한다)에 관한 각종 위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 12. Operation of various committees concerning taxation (excluding customs duties)

rows.source_ko: 13. 세무사제도의 기획ㆍ운영ㆍ입안 및 세무사징계위원회 운영 등 세무사의 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 13. Management and supervision of tax accountants, including the planning, operation, and drafting of the tax accountant system and the operation of the Tax Accountant Disciplinary Committee

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 실 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the building

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 조세특례제도과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Special Tax Treatment System Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「조세특례제한법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, drafting, and overall management and coordination of systems related to the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「교육세법」(금융ㆍ보험업자에 관한 사항은 제외한다) 및 「농어촌특별세법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and drafting of systems under the Education Tax Act (excluding matters concerning financial and insurance business operators) and the Special Tax Act for Rural and Fishing Villages

rows.source_ko: 3. 「조세특례제한법」과 「지방세특례제한법」의 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Adjustment of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act and the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 목적세 관련 제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Planning, drafting, and overall management and coordination of earmarked tax systems

rows.source_ko: 5. 제1호와 제2호에 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 5. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general guidelines on national taxation related to Subparagraphs 1 and 2

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 조세특례제도 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters concerning the operation of the special tax treatment system

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 조세추계과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 11 The Head of the Tax Estimation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 소득세ㆍ법인세 등 소득 관련 세목의 세입계획 수립과 세입예산 편성
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of revenue plans and formulation of revenue budgets for income-related tax items, such as income tax and corporate tax

rows.source_ko: 2. 부가가치세ㆍ개별소비세 등 소비 관련 세목의 세입계획 수립과 세입예산 편성
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of revenue plans and formulation of revenue budgets for consumption-related tax items, such as Value Added Tax and Individual Consumption Tax

rows.source_ko: 3. 금융재산ㆍ부동산 등 자산 관련 세목의 세입계획 수립과 세입예산 편성
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of revenue plans and formulation of revenue budgets for tax items related to assets, such as financial assets and real estate

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 외 내국세 세목 및 관세의 세입계획 수립과 세입예산 편성
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of revenue plans and formulation of revenue budgets for other domestic tax items and customs duties

rows.source_ko: 5. 중장기 세입전망 및 중장기 재원확보 대책의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and coordination of mid-to-long-term revenue forecasts and mid-to-long-term financial securing measures

rows.source_ko: 6. 과학적인 세수추계 방법에 관한 연구 및 개발
rows.text_en: 6. Research and Development on Scientific Revenue Estimation Methods

rows.source_ko: 7. 세수추계와 관련된 위원회의 운영 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Operation and overall management of the committee related to tax revenue estimation

rows.source_ko: 8. 세수추계 관련 대외협력 및 국제협력
rows.text_en: 8. External and International Cooperation Related to Revenue Estimates

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 조세분석과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 12 The Head of the Tax Analysis Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 조세제도의 정책효과 분석ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Analysis and Overview of Policy Effects of the Tax System

rows.source_ko: 2. 조세통계자료 및 조세관련 지표의 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 2. Investigation and Analysis of Tax Statistical Data and Tax-Related Indicators

rows.source_ko: 3. 국세와 각종 부담금 및 세외수입간의 조정 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management of coordination between national taxes, various levies, and non-tax revenues

rows.source_ko: 4. 국세와 지방세 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정 및 「국세와 지방세의 조정 등에 관한 법률」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and coordination of national and local tax policies, and planning and drafting of systems related to the "Act on the Adjustment, etc. of National and Local Taxes"

rows.source_ko: 5. 내국세ㆍ관세 등의 세수실적 분석
rows.text_en: 5. Analysis of Tax Revenue Performance for Domestic Taxes, Customs Duties, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 매년도 「조세특례 및 그 제한에 관한 기본계획」의 수립ㆍ통보
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and notification of the annual "Basic Plan on Special Tax Treatment and Restrictions Thereon"

rows.source_ko: 7. 중앙행정기관의 장이 제출한 조세지출건의서 및 조세지출 관련 평가 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Evaluation and overall coordination of tax expenditure proposals and tax expenditures submitted by the heads of central administrative agencies

rows.source_ko: 8. 조세지출예산서 작성 제출
rows.text_en: 8. Preparation and submission of the tax expenditure budget

rows.source_ko: 9. 「조세특례제한법」 제142조제4항 및 제5항에 따른 주요 조세특례 또는 신규 도입 조세특례에 대한 평가의 수행 및 관리
rows.text_en: 9. Performance and management of evaluations of major special tax provisions or newly introduced special tax provisions pursuant to Article 142, Paragraphs 4 and 5 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 10. 「조세특례제한법」 제142조제4항 및 제5항에 따른 조세특례에 대한 평가 결과와 세법 개정과의 연계에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the linkage between the evaluation results of special tax treatments under Article 142, Paragraphs 4 and 5 of the Restriction of Special Tax Treatment Act and amendments to tax laws

rows.source_ko: 11. 외국 조세제도 동향 조사 및 국내 조세제도와의 비교ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 11. Investigation of Trends in Foreign Tax Systems and Comparison and Analysis with Domestic Tax Systems

rows.source_ko: 12. 조세경쟁력 지표 및 국세통계 관련 국제협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning international cooperation regarding tax competitiveness indicators and national tax statistics

rows.source_ko: 13. 세법 개정과 관련된 홍보 총괄
rows.text_en: 13. Overall management of public relations related to tax law revisions

rows.source_ko: ⑬ 소득세제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 13 The Head of the Income Tax Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 소득관련 세제의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, drafting, and overall coordination of income-related tax systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 「소득세법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안. 다만, 이자ㆍ배당소득, 양도소득 및 국제조세에 관한 사항은 제외한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and drafting of systems related to the Income Tax Act . Provided, however, that matters concerning interest and dividend income, capital gains, and international taxation are excluded.

rows.source_ko: 3. 「조세특례제한법」 중 제2호에 규정된 법률과 관련된 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 3. Planning and drafting of systems related to the laws stipulated in Subparagraph 2 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 제2호 및 제3호에 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본 통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 4. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general rules on national taxation related to Subparagraphs 2 and 3

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 소득세제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters concerning the income tax system

rows.source_ko: ⑭ 법인세제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 14. The Head of the Corporate Tax Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인 관련 세제의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, drafting, and overall coordination of corporate tax systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 「법인세법」(토지 등 양도소득에 대한 과세특례, 국제조세에 관한 사항은 제외한다)에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and drafting of systems regarding the Corporate Tax Act (excluding special taxation provisions for capital gains on the transfer of land, etc., and matters concerning international taxation)

rows.source_ko: 3. 「자산재평가법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 3. Planning and drafting of the system regarding the Asset Revaluation Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「조세특례제한법」 중 제2호 및 제3호에 규정된 법률과 관련된 제도의 입안
rows.text_en: 4. Drafting of systems related to the laws stipulated in Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 「과세자료의 제출 및 관리에 관한 법률」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 5. Planning and drafting of systems related to the Act on the Submission and Management of Tax Data

rows.source_ko: 6. 제2호부터 제5호까지에 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 6. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general guidelines on national taxation related to Subparagraphs 2 through 5

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 법인세제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters concerning the corporate tax system

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 금융세제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 15. The Head of the Financial and Taxation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「소득세법」 중 이자ㆍ배당소득, 주식ㆍ출자지분 및 그 밖의 금융자산의 양도소득에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 1. Planning and enactment of systems regarding interest and dividend income, and capital gains from the transfer of stocks, equity shares, and other financial assets under the Income Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「증권거래세법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and drafting of the system regarding the Securities Transaction Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「교육세법」(금융ㆍ보험업자에 관한 사항에 한정한다)에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 3. Planning and drafting of systems regarding the Education Tax Act (limited to matters concerning financial and insurance business operators)

rows.source_ko: 4. 「조세특례제한법」 중 제1호부터 제3호까지에 규정된 법률과 관련된 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 4. Planning and drafting of systems related to the laws stipulated in Subparagraphs 1 through 3 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 제1호부터 제4호까지에 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본 통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 5. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general rules on national taxation related to Items 1 through 4

rows.source_ko: ⑯ 재산세제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 16. The Head of the Property Tax Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 재산 관련 세제의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, drafting, and overall management and coordination of property-related tax systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 「소득세법」 중 양도소득세에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안(제9항제1호에 따라 금융세제과의 주관에 속하는 사항은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and drafting of systems regarding capital gains tax under the Income Tax Act (excluding matters falling under the jurisdiction of the Financial Taxation Division pursuant to Paragraph 9, Subparagraph 1)

rows.source_ko: 3. 「법인세법」 중 토지 등 양도소득에 대한 과세특례에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 3. Planning and drafting of the system regarding special taxation provisions for capital gains on the transfer of land, etc. under the Corporate Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「상속세 및 증여세법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 4. Planning and drafting of systems related to the Inheritance Tax and Gift Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 「조세특례제한법」 중 제2호부터 제4호까지에 규정된 법률과 관련된 제도의 입안
rows.text_en: 5. Drafting of systems related to the laws stipulated in subparagraphs 2 through 4 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 제2호부터 제5호까지에 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본 통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 6. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general rules on national taxation related to Subparagraphs 2 through 5

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 재산 관련 세제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters concerning property-related taxation

rows.source_ko: ⑰ 부가가치세제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 17 The Head of the Value Added Tax Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「부가가치세법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 1. Planning and drafting of systems related to the Value Added Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「인지세법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and drafting of the system regarding the Stamp Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「조세특례제한법」 중 제1호 및 제2호에 규정된 법률과 관련된 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 3. Planning and drafting of systems related to the laws stipulated in Subparagraphs 1 and 2 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 제1호부터 제3호까지에 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본 통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 4. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general rules on national taxation related to Subparagraphs 1 through 3

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 부가가치세제 및 인지세제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters concerning the value-added tax system and the stamp duty system

rows.source_ko: ⑱ 환경에너지세제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 18. The Head of the Environment and Energy Taxation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 환경ㆍ에너지 관련 세제의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, drafting, and overall management and coordination of environment and energy-related tax systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 신재생에너지에 대한 세제지원 정책의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and Drafting of Tax Support Policies for New and Renewable Energy

rows.source_ko: 3. 「교통ㆍ에너지ㆍ환경세법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 3. Planning and drafting of systems related to the "Traffic, Energy, and Environment Tax Act"

rows.source_ko: 4. 「개별소비세법」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 4. Planning and drafting of systems related to the Special Consumption Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 「주세법」 및 「주류 면허 등에 관한 법률」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 5. Planning and drafting of systems related to the “Liquor Tax Act” and the “Act on Liquor Licenses, etc.”

rows.source_ko: 6. 「조세특례제한법」 중 제3호부터 제5호까지에 규정된 법률과 관련된 제도의 입안
rows.text_en: 6. Drafting of systems related to the laws stipulated in subparagraphs 3 through 5 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 7. 제3호부터 제6호까지에 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 7. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general guidelines on national taxation related to Subparagraphs 3 through 6

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 에너지ㆍ환경ㆍ개별소비세제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters concerning energy, environment, and individual consumption tax systems

rows.source_ko: ⑲ 국제조세제도과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 19. The Head of the International Taxation System Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국제조세 정책 및 제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, formulation, and overall management of international tax policies and systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 「국제조세조정에 관한 법률」에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and drafting of the system regarding the "Act on the Adjustment of International Taxation"

rows.source_ko: 3. 「소득세법」, 「법인세법」 및 「조세특례제한법」 중 비거주자와 외국법인에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 3. Planning and enactment of systems concerning non-residents and foreign corporations under the Income Tax Act , the Corporate Tax Act , and the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「조세특례제한법」 중 외국인투자 관련 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 4. Planning and drafting of foreign investment-related systems under the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 제2호부터 제4호까지와 관련된 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 5. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, precedents, and general guidelines on national taxation related to Subparagraphs 2 through 4

rows.source_ko: 6. 경제협력개발기구(OECD) 재정위원회와 관련된 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of affairs related to the OECD Fiscal Committee

rows.source_ko: 7. 다국적기업의 소득이전을 통한 세원잠식 문제(BEPS) 방지를 위한 포괄적 국제조세협력 이행체계(Inclusive Framework)와 관련된 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Matters related to the Inclusive Framework for International Tax Cooperation to prevent Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) by multinational corporations

rows.source_ko: 8. 외국투자자와의 조세협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning tax cooperation with foreign investors

rows.source_ko: 9. 외국과의 조세조약 및 국가 간 금융정보의 교환을 위한 협정에 관한 제도의 기획ㆍ입안
rows.text_en: 9. Planning and drafting of systems regarding tax treaties with foreign countries and agreements for the exchange of financial information between countries

rows.source_ko: 10. 외국과의 조세조약 및 국가 간 금융정보의 교환을 위한 협정 체결 및 개정 협상 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management of negotiations for the conclusion and revision of tax treaties with foreign countries and agreements for the exchange of financial information between nations

rows.source_ko: 11. 외국과의 조세조약 및 국가 간 금융정보의 교환을 위한 협정에 관한 해석 및 상호합의
rows.text_en: 11. Interpretation and Mutual Agreement on Tax Treaties with Foreign Countries and Agreements for the Exchange of Financial Information Between Countries

rows.source_ko: 12. 외국과의 조세조약 및 국가 간 금융정보의 교환을 위한 협정에 관한 국세청의 훈령ㆍ예규 및 국세기본통칙의 심사
rows.text_en: 12. Examination of the National Tax Service's directives, guidelines, and general principles of national taxation concerning tax treaties with foreign countries and agreements for the exchange of financial information between countries

rows.source_ko: 13. 외국과의 양자 및 다자간 국제조세 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning bilateral and multilateral international tax cooperation with foreign countries

rows.source_ko: 14. 자유무역협정(FTA) 조세 분야에 관한 협상
rows.text_en: 14. Negotiations on the Tax Sector of Free Trade Agreements (FTAs)

rows.source_ko: 15. 조세투명성 및 정보교환을 위한 글로벌 포럼에 관련된 업무
rows.text_en: 15. Work related to the Global Forum for Tax Transparency and Information Exchange

rows.source_ko: 16. 그 밖에 국제조세제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Other matters concerning the international tax system

rows.source_ko: ⑳ 관세제도과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 20 The Head of the Customs System Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 관세정책의 기획ㆍ조정 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, coordination, and overall management of customs policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 관세환급제도의 기획 및 입안
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and Drafting of the Customs Duty Refund System

rows.source_ko: 3. 보세제도의 기획 및 입안
rows.text_en: 3. Planning and Drafting of the Bonded Warehouse System

rows.source_ko: 4. 통관관리제도의 기획 및 입안
rows.text_en: 4. Planning and Drafting of Customs Management Systems

rows.source_ko: 5. 관세감면과 분할납부제도의 기획 및 입안
rows.text_en: 5. Planning and Drafting of Customs Duty Reduction and Installment Payment Systems

rows.source_ko: 6. 관세평가 제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 운용
rows.text_en: 6. Planning, Drafting, and Operation of the Customs Valuation System

rows.source_ko: 7. 관세형벌 및 관세범처벌 절차에 관한 제도의 기획 및 입안
rows.text_en: 7. Planning and drafting of systems regarding customs criminal penalties and procedures for punishing customs offenses

rows.source_ko: 8. 관세사제도의 기획 및 입안
rows.text_en: 8. Planning and Drafting of the Customs Broker System

rows.source_ko: 9. 관세에 관한 각종 위원회 운용
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of various committees concerning customs

rows.source_ko: 10. 남북 관세협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning inter-Korean customs cooperation

rows.source_ko: 11. 자유무역지역에 관한 사항 중 재정경제부 소관 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning free trade zones under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance and Economy

rows.source_ko: 12. 수입물품 원산지제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 운용
rows.text_en: 12. Planning, Drafting, and Operation of the Rule of Origin System for Imported Goods

rows.source_ko: 13. 그 밖에 관세에 관한 업무 중 실내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Other matters concerning customs duties that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the office

rows.source_ko: ㉑ 산업관세과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 21 The Head of the Industrial Customs Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 관세율정책의 기획ㆍ조정 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, coordination, and overall management of tariff rate policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 긴급관세ㆍ조정관세ㆍ계절관세 및 할당관세 등 탄력관세제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Planning, drafting, and coordination of flexible tariff systems, such as emergency tariffs, adjustment tariffs, seasonal tariffs, and tariff quotas

rows.source_ko: 3. 보복관세제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 운용
rows.text_en: 3. Planning, Drafting, and Operation of the Retaliatory Tariff System

rows.source_ko: 4. 덤핑방지관세제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 운용
rows.text_en: 4. Planning, Drafting, and Operation of the Anti-Dumping Duty System

rows.source_ko: 5. 보조금 및 상계관세제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 운용
rows.text_en: 5. Planning, Drafting, and Operation of Subsidies and Countervailing Duty Systems

rows.source_ko: 6. 임시수입부가세와 간이세율제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 조정
rows.text_en: 6. Planning, Drafting, and Coordination of Temporary Import Surtax and Simplified Tax Rate System

rows.source_ko: 7. 품목분류와 국제통일상품분류제도 및 관세ㆍ통계통합품목분류표에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning commodity classification, the Harmonized Commodity Classification System, and the Harmonized Tariff and Statistical Commodity Classification Table

rows.source_ko: 8. 농ㆍ림ㆍ축산물에 대한 특별긴급관세 및 세계무역기구 협정에 의한 농ㆍ림ㆍ축산물에 대한 시장접근물량 조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning special emergency tariffs on agricultural, forestry, and livestock products and the adjustment of market access volumes for agricultural, forestry, and livestock products under the World Trade Organization agreement

rows.source_ko: 9. 수출입 통계 및 산업별 동향 점검ㆍ분석에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the review and analysis of import and export statistics and industry-specific trends

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 관세율 및 품목분류에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters concerning tariff rates and commodity classification

rows.source_ko: ㉒ 관세협력과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 22 The Head of the Customs Cooperation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 세계무역기구 관세 관련 협상 및 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning negotiations and cooperation regarding tariffs with the World Trade Organization

rows.source_ko: 2. 세계관세기구 관세협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning customs cooperation with the World Customs Organization

rows.source_ko: 3. 아시아태평양경제협력체ㆍ아시아유럽정상회의ㆍ국제연합아시아태평양경제사회이사회 및 국제연합무역개발회의 등 그 밖의 국제기구 관세협상 및 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning customs negotiations and cooperation with other international organizations, such as the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, the Summit of Asia and Europe, the United Nations Economic and Social Council for Asia and the Pacific, and the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development.

rows.source_ko: 4. 국제 관세협력에 관한 정책의 수립 및 국제협약에의 가입과 운용
rows.text_en: 4. Formulation of policies on international customs cooperation and accession to and operation of international conventions

rows.source_ko: 5. 편익관세 제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 운용
rows.text_en: 5. Planning, Drafting, and Operation of the Beneficial Tariff System

rows.source_ko: 6. 일반특혜관세제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 운용
rows.text_en: 6. Planning, Drafting, and Operation of the Generalized System of Preferences

rows.source_ko: 7. 관세와 관련된 국제 동향의 조사 및 분석
rows.text_en: 7. Investigation and Analysis of International Trends Related to Tariffs

rows.source_ko: 8. 자유무역협정 체결과 관련된 관세정책의 기획ㆍ조정 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Planning, coordination, and overall management of customs policies related to the conclusion of Free Trade Agreements

rows.source_ko: 9. 자유무역협정 체결과 관련된 원산지ㆍ통관ㆍ무역구제 등 관세와 관련되는 협상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning negotiations related to customs, such as rules of origin, customs clearance, and trade remedies, in connection with the conclusion of free trade agreements

rows.source_ko: 10. 자유무역협정 체결과 관련된 상품양허 분야 협상대책의 수립ㆍ조정 및 교섭에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the establishment, coordination, and negotiation of negotiation measures in the field of goods concessions related to the conclusion of free trade agreements

rows.source_ko: 11. 다자ㆍ양자간 관세 협의ㆍ협력과 관련된 업무(제18항제5호에 따른 업무는 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 11. Matters related to multilateral and bilateral customs consultations and cooperation (excluding matters under Paragraph 18, Subparagraph 5)

rows.source_ko: 12. 한ㆍ미행정협정 중 재정경제부 소관사항의 총괄
rows.text_en: 12. Overall management of matters under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance and Economy within the Korea-U.S. Administrative Agreement

rows.source_ko: 13. 그 밖에 관세와 관련되는 다자ㆍ양자간 협약 및 협상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Other matters concerning multilateral and bilateral agreements and negotiations related to customs duties

rows.source_ko: ㉓ 자유무역협정관세이행과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 23 The Head of the Free Trade Agreement Tariff Implementation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 자유무역협정의 국내이행과 관련된 관세특례법령의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, drafting, and overall management of special customs laws and regulations related to the domestic implementation of Free Trade Agreements

rows.source_ko: 2. 자유무역협정의 국내이행과 관련된 상품양허ㆍ원산지ㆍ무역구제ㆍ통관 등 관세분야 제도의 기획ㆍ입안 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Planning, drafting, and overall management and coordination of customs systems, such as tariff concessions, rules of origin, trade remedies, and customs clearance, related to the domestic implementation of Free Trade Agreements.

rows.source_ko: 3. 체결된 자유무역협정의 개선ㆍ보완 등과 관련된 상품양허ㆍ원산지ㆍ무역구제ㆍ통관 등 관세분야 협상대책의 수립ㆍ조정 및 교섭에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the establishment, coordination, and negotiation of negotiation measures in the customs sector, such as tariff concessions, rules of origin, trade remedies, and customs clearance, related to the improvement or supplementation of concluded free trade agreements

rows.source_ko: 4. 자유무역협정 상품양허ㆍ원산지ㆍ무역구제ㆍ통관 등 관세분야의 이행협의기구 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the operation of the implementation consultative body in the customs sector, including goods concessions, rules of origin, trade remedies, and customs clearance under the Free Trade Agreement

rows.source_ko: 5. 자유무역협정 체약상대국의 상품양허ㆍ원산지ㆍ무역구제ㆍ통관 등 관세분야의 이행 점검 및 후속조치와 관세상호협의제도 등 이행 협의ㆍ협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the monitoring of implementation and follow-up measures in the customs sector, such as goods concessions, rules of origin, trade remedies, and customs clearance, of Free Trade Agreement partner countries, as well as consultation and cooperation on implementation, including the customs mutual consultation system.

rows.source_ko: 제15조(국고실) ① 국고실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Treasury Office) ① The Head of the Treasury Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「재정경제부 직제」 제18조제1항에 따라 국고실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 국고정책관ㆍ국유재산정책관 및 조달계약정책관으로 하며, 국고정책관ㆍ국유재산정책관 및 조달계약정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 18 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Treasury Policy Office shall be the Director of Treasury Policy, the Director of State Property Policy, and the Director of Procurement and Contract Policy; the Director of Treasury Policy, the Director of State Property Policy, and the Director of Procurement and Contract Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국고정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제18조제3항제1호부터 제21호까지의 사항에 관하여 국고실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of National Treasury Policy assists the Director of the National Treasury Office with respect to matters under Article 18, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 1 through 21 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ④ 국유재산정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제18조제3항제22호부터 제29호까지의 사항에 관하여 국고실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of State Property Policy assists the Director of the Treasury Office with respect to matters under subparagraphs 22 through 29 of Article 18 , Paragraph 3 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 조달계약정책관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제18조제3항제30호부터 제35호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of Procurement and Contract Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under subparagraphs 30 through 35 of Article 18 , Paragraph 3 of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 국고실에 국고총괄과ㆍ국채정책과ㆍ국채시장과ㆍ출자관리과ㆍ회계결산과ㆍ국유재산정책과ㆍ국유재산개발과ㆍ국유재산조정과ㆍ조달정책과 및 계약정책과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Treasury Office shall have the Treasury General Affairs Division, National Debt Policy Division, National Debt Market Division, Investment Management Division, Accounting Settlement Division, State Property Policy Division, State Property Development Division, State Property Coordination Division, Procurement Policy Division, and Contract Policy Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 국고총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the National Treasury Management Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국고의 관리ㆍ운영에 관한 정책 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall policy on the management and operation of the national treasury

rows.source_ko: 2. 국고자금계획의 수립ㆍ집행 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment, Execution, and Coordination of National Treasury Fund Plans

rows.source_ko: 3. 재정 수입ㆍ지출 제도의 관리 및 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Management and Operation of Fiscal Revenue and Expenditure Systems

rows.source_ko: 4. 국고금 관련 법령의 입안ㆍ해석 및 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Drafting, Interpretation, and Operation of Laws Related to State Funds

rows.source_ko: 5. 국고여유자금의 관리 및 운용
rows.text_en: 5. Management and Operation of State Surplus Funds

rows.source_ko: 6. 세계잉여금의 집계 및 활용
rows.text_en: 6. Aggregation and Utilization of Global Surplus

rows.source_ko: 7. 한국은행으로부터의 차입
rows.text_en: 7. Borrowing from the Bank of Korea

rows.source_ko: 8. 한국은행의 국고금 출납사무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 8. Guidance and Supervision of the Bank of Korea's Treasury Fund Disbursement Affairs

rows.source_ko: 9. 공공자금관리기금의 관리ㆍ운용 및 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Management and operation of the Public Funds Management Fund and formulation and overall management of related policies

rows.source_ko: 10. 공공자금관리기금법령의 입안ㆍ해석 및 운용
rows.text_en: 10. Drafting, Interpretation, and Operation of Public Funds Management Fund Act and Regulations

rows.source_ko: 11. 공공자금관리기금운용위원회에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the Public Funds Management Fund Operation Committee

rows.source_ko: 12. 재정차관 및 정부보증차관의 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Management of Fiscal Loans and Government-Guaranteed Loans

rows.source_ko: 13. 수입인지의 발행 및 제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 13. Issuance of Revenue Stamps and Operation of the System

rows.source_ko: 14. 한국조폐공사의 업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the business of the Korea Mint Corporation

rows.source_ko: 15. 국가채권, 세외수입 등 관리의 총괄
rows.text_en: 15. Overall management of state bonds, non-tax revenues, etc.

rows.source_ko: 16. 국가의 채무보증과 보증채무의 분석ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 16. State Debt Guarantees and Analysis and Management of Guaranteed Obligations

rows.source_ko: 17. 국가자산 및 부채 관리
rows.text_en: 17. Management of State Assets and Liabilities

rows.source_ko: 18. 국고 관련 재정정보 관리 업무 등 그 밖에 실 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Duties regarding the management of financial information related to the national treasury, and other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the office

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 국채정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the National Debt Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국채 정책의 수립ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation and overall management of government debt policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 국채의 발행 및 상환
rows.text_en: 2. Issuance and Redemption of Government Bonds

rows.source_ko: 3. 국채 상환기일 이전의 매입ㆍ교환 등 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of purchases, exchanges, etc. prior to the redemption date of government bonds

rows.source_ko: 4. 국채 이자비용 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of Government Bond Interest Expenses

rows.source_ko: 5. 국채 제도의 연구ㆍ발전에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the research and development of the government debt system

rows.source_ko: 6. 국채 및 국채 관련 상품의 개발ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 6. Development and management of government bonds and government bond-related products

rows.source_ko: 7. 국고채권의 입찰 및 시장조성 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the bidding and market making of government bonds, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 국채 관련 법령의 입안ㆍ해석 및 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Drafting, Interpretation, and Operation of Government Debt-Related Laws

rows.source_ko: 9. 외국의 국채 제도 연구 및 대외협력
rows.text_en: 9. Research on Foreign Government Debt Systems and External Cooperation

rows.source_ko: 10. 국채 관련 자료 발간
rows.text_en: 10. Publication of materials related to government bonds

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 국채시장과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Government Bond Market Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국채시장 및 국채 연관시장 동향 분석
rows.text_en: 1. Analysis of Trends in the Government Bond Market and Government Bond-Related Markets

rows.source_ko: 2. 국내 투자자별 국채 투자 동향 분석
rows.text_en: 2. Analysis of Government Bond Investment Trends by Domestic Investor Type

rows.source_ko: 3. 국채시장 위험관리 및 시장 안정에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Duties regarding government bond market risk management and market stability

rows.source_ko: 4. 국채 관련 파생상품 제도 및 시장 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the system and market management of derivatives related to government bonds

rows.source_ko: 5. 국채시장 관련 금융정책에 관한 협의
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation on financial policy regarding the government bond market

rows.source_ko: 6. 국채 관련 외국인 투자 동향 분석
rows.text_en: 6. Analysis of Foreign Investment Trends in Government Bonds

rows.source_ko: 7. 국채 관련 외국인 투자 정책에 관한 협의
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation on foreign investment policies regarding government bonds

rows.source_ko: 8. 국채 관련 외국인 투자 유치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the attraction of foreign investment related to government bonds

rows.source_ko: 9. 국내외 국채시장 참가자 관리ㆍ협력
rows.text_en: 9. Management and Cooperation of Domestic and Foreign Government Bond Market Participants

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 출자관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of Investment Management Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 정부 출자 정책의 수립 및 집행 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of the formulation and execution of government investment policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 정부 출자금 예산의 집행
rows.text_en: 2. Execution of Government Capital Contribution Budget

rows.source_ko: 3. 국유재산 현물출자의 결정ㆍ집행
rows.text_en: 3. Decision and Execution of Contribution in Kind of State-Owned Property

rows.source_ko: 4. 정부 출자에 따른 주주권, 그 밖의 권리의 행사
rows.text_en: 4. Exercise of shareholder rights and other rights arising from government investment

rows.source_ko: 5. 정부 출자에 따른 배당정책의 수립 및 집행
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and execution of dividend policy following government investment

rows.source_ko: 6. 정부세외수입 수납 관리 및 점검
rows.text_en: 6. Management and Inspection of Government Non-Tax Revenue Collection

rows.source_ko: 7. 정부소유 유가증권의 관리ㆍ처분
rows.text_en: 7. Management and Disposal of Government-Owned Securities

rows.source_ko: 8. 정부소유 주식 매각가격 산정 자문위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Operation of the Advisory Committee on the Calculation of the Sale Price of Government-Owned Stocks

rows.source_ko: 9. 국세물납유가증권 관리정책의 수립ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and Operation of Management Policy for Securities Paid in Kind

rows.source_ko: 제16조(경제정책국) ① 경제정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Economic Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Economic Policy Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 「재정경제부 직제」 제19조제1항에 따라 경제정책국장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 거시경제심의관으로 하며, 거시경제심의관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy,” the advisory body placed under the Director of the Economic Policy Bureau shall be the Director of Macroeconomics, and the Director of Macroeconomics shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 거시경제심의관은 「재정경제부 직제」 제19조제3항제4호, 제8호, 제11호 및 제14호의 사항에 관하여 국장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Macroeconomic Affairs assists the Director with regard to matters under Article 19 , Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 4 , 8 , 11 , and 14 of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy .

rows.source_ko: ④ 경제정책국에 종합정책과ㆍ경제분석과ㆍ자금시장정책과ㆍ자금시장분석과ㆍ부동산시장과 및 재정기획과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Economic Policy Bureau shall have the Comprehensive Policy Division, Economic Analysis Division, Money Market Policy Division, Money Market Analysis Division, Real Estate Market Division, and Fiscal Planning Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.
