rows.source_ko: 제3장 공무원의 정원
rows.text_en: Chapter 3 Staffing of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제23조(재정경제부에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 재정경제부에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 1과 같다. 다만, 「재정경제부 직제」 제27조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 1에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in the Ministry of Finance and Economy) ① The personnel quotas for public officials in the Ministry of Finance and Economy by rank ( excluding temporary quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies; hereinafter the same shall apply in this Article) shall be as set forth in Table 1. However,pursuant to the proviso to Article 27, Paragraph 1 of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota set forth in Table 1 , shall be as set forth in Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 재정경제부에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 64명(3급 또는 4급 4명, 4급 10명, 4급 또는 5급 4명, 5급 25명, 6급 11명, 7급 10명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of Finance and Economy, 64 (4 in Grade 3 or 4, 10 in Grade 4, 4 in Grade 4 or 5, 25 in Grade 5, 11 in Grade 6, and 10 in Grade 7) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials.

rows.source_ko: ③ 재정경제부에 두는 공무원 정원 중 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 2명(5급 1명, 6급 1명), 기후변화 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명), 디지털소통 홍보 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 국가 재무결산 업무를 담당하는 1명(6급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Among the civil servant positions in the Ministry of Finance and Economy, two people in charge of public data-related duties (one at Grade 5 and one at Grade 6), one person in charge of climate change-related duties (one at Grade 5), one person in charge of digital communication and public relations duties (one at Grade 5), and one person in charge of national financial settlement duties (one at Grade 6) shall be appointed as fixed-term civil servants.

rows.source_ko: 제24조(시간선택제채용공무원 정원의 운영) 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제24조제3항 및 「공무원임용령」 제3조의3제1항에 따라 재정경제부에 두는 시간선택제채용공무원 정원은 재정경제부에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 일부를 활용하여 운영할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Operation of Quotas for Part-time Public Officials) Pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and Article 3-3, Paragraph 1 of the “Public Officials Appointment Decree,” the quota for part-time public officials in the Ministry of Finance and Economy may be operated by utilizing a portion of the quota for public officials in the Ministry of Finance and Economy.

rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① Among the personnel quotas whose job grades were upgraded due to the enforcement of the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Economy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Economy and Finance Decree No. 922, including the contents amended pursuant to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Economy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Economy and Finance Decree No. 1014), the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Economy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Economy and Finance Decree No. 1067), and the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Economy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Economy and Finance Decree No. 1142), the quota of 9 positions specified in Annex 2 (8 Administrative Officers, and 1 Administrative Officer, Computer Officer, Facilities Officer, Agricultural Officer, Environmental Officer, Industrial Officer, Librarian Officer, or Archives Research Officer) shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and thereafter, the corresponding personnel quota [is] Annex It is considered to have a staff of 9 (9 administrative clerks) of 2.

rows.text_en: ② Among the personnel quotas whose ranks have been raised due to the enforcement of the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Strategy and Finance Decree No. 1067, including the contents amended pursuant to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and its Affiliated Agencies, Ministry of Strategy and Finance Decree No. 1142), the quota of 6 positions in Table 2 (3 Senior Officials or Administrative Officers, 3 Administrative Officers) shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and thereafter, the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to be the quota of 6 positions in Table 2 (3 Administrative Officers, 3 Administrative Assistants).
